zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: surface town, stars, Elderbug, central well

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: brown tunnels, infected orange variant later
zones.note: Revealable from the start: descending the well is the intended first step, not a spoiler.

zones.name: Greenpath

zones.name: City of Tears

abilities.name: City Crest

objectives.name: Descend into the Crossroads
objectives.hopDescription: Head down the well in the middle of town — that drops you into the Forgotten Crossroads.

objectives.name: Explore the Crossroads
objectives.hopDescription: Sweep the Crossroads — there's plenty to find, and a big armored knight down here worth taking on.

objectives.name: Head to Greenpath
objectives.hopDescription: Take the western exit out of the Crossroads toward the green, overgrown area.

objectives.name: Find the dash
objectives.hopDescription: Push deeper into Greenpath — there's a movement ability to grab that opens the map right up.

connectors.description: The well in Dirtmouth down to the Forgotten Crossroads.
Western passage from the Crossroads into Greenpath.
Descent from the Crossroads toward the Fungal Wastes.
Southern route from Greenpath into the Fungal Wastes.
Eastern climb from the Fungal Wastes up into the City of Tears.
